settings.heading: A consumer platform, not a flower shop
settings.text: Mystery Flower Box connects supermarket retail, ecommerce, subscriptions, loyalty and retail media into one measurable growth engine.

settings.heading: Company profile
settings.content:
Mystery Flower Box buys surplus stock from Dutch growers and sells it as a fixed-price surprise box through supermarkets and direct ecommerce. The model removes choice paralysis, removes waste, and creates a product customers photograph and share.

Revenue streams

  • Direct ecommerce — one-off boxes and prepaid bundles
  • Subscriptions — weekly, fortnightly and monthly rhythms
  • Retail wholesale — supermarket and independent stockists
  • Retail media — sampling, inserts, sponsorship and co-branded competitions
  • Corporate gifting — employee and client programmes
  • Future territory licensing

Strategic priorities

  • Convert supermarket purchasers into known digital customers via QR registration
  • Build the largest first-party flower customer database in Europe
  • Grow subscription share of revenue
  • Monetise the box itself as a media channel

settings.heading: Phase 3 · Commercial

settings.heading: Phase 4 · International
